name: Private Pilot written exam prep
summary: A practice-question subscription for the FAA written exam, not a video ground school.
priceLabel: $19.99 a month, $49.99 every 3 months, or $179.99 a year
accessTerm: Subscription; cancel any time; one subscription covers one exam at a time
endorsementNote: The page lists a question bank and study tools, not a ground school endorsement.
guarantee: Says it has a pass guarantee on the quarterly and annual plans.
includes: Practice questions aligned to the FAA Airman Certification Standards (not the FAA's own test questions)
Spaced repetition review and an exam readiness score
watchOut: It prepares you for the written test only. A student who needs an endorsement from a ground school course needs a course.
The monthly plan has no pass guarantee, per the page.
